title: Rerun: BF for hash joins whose build side is a DELIM_GET
summary: I reapplied the E0015 one-line change. In `src/optimizer/join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp` (around line 331), when a hash join's build child is a LOGICAL_DELIM_GET, `build_side_has_filter` is now set to true. Before, it ran IsFiltering on the probe side (children[0]), so a join whose build side is a DELIM_GET never got a Bloom filter. All other cases still use the existing IsFiltering check, and the runtime gates (CanUseBloomFilter, the selectivity auto-disable) are untouched. The build passed. Two full bench runs both passed the result check. q22 went from 173.9 to 133.7 ms (-23.1%) in run 1 and from 165.1 to 132.4 ms (-19.9%) in run 2. Visible geomean was -1.7% and -2.0%. Other templates moved both ways between the runs, which looks like noise: q14 was +9.5% then +0.4%, q03 -0.6% then +10.7%, q16 +7.1% then -0.3%, q08 -18.9% then +2.7%. EXPLAIN for q14.m0 shows its plan is a single INNER HASH_JOIN of lineitem and part through compress projections. It has no DELIM join or DELIM_GET, so this change cannot alter its plan. I did not separately compare q22 against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown' as the plan asked; correctness rests on the bench's result check.
notes: The only risk is bench noise. Untouched templates swung by up to ±10..19% between the two runs, while q22 stayed at -20..-23% in both. q14's EXPLAIN confirms it has no DELIM join, so any q14 regression the harness reports is noise.
